Well-Being and Basic Needs Survey, 2019 (Individual-Level)

WBBN2019.Rd

This subset of data comes from one iteration of the Well-Being and Basic Needs Survey, administered in 2019. These data were collected by the Urban Institute. Information about the data set can be found in the WBBN2019 Codebook at: https://burrelvannjr.com/docs/WBBN2019_Codebook.pdf.

Usage

WBBN2019

Format

A data frame with 7694 observations and 23 variables.
